I couldn't merge this branch: Insufficient approvals (have: [] missing: 1)

I haven't looked that much into the BIG/BIS part of the specification yet, but as far as I can understand you are calculating and displaying all of the possible access addresses here.
But since the access addresses are not actually included in the packet they should be marked as generated values with proto_item_set_generated.

How does it work to add the same proto item many times?
Shouldn't it be an else handling for when you have connection_info here? Should be able to set the address?
